questions.questionTextEn: Who is the ﬁ rst Lokpal of our country?
questions.questionTextHi: हमारे देश का पहला लोकपाल कौन है?
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (B). The Administrative Reforms Commission (ARC) of India (1966-1970) recommended the setting up of two special authorities designated as 'Lokpal' and 'Lokayukta' for the redressal of citizen's grievances. According to the ARC, the chairperson and members shall be appointed by the President after obtaining the recommendations of a selection committee consisting of – (a) the Prime Minister – Chairperson (b) the speaker of the Lok Sabha (c) the leader of opposition in the Lok Sabha (d) the Chief Justice of India or a Judge of the Supreme Court nominated by him. (e) one eminent jurist. Recently, Justice Pinaki Chandra Ghose has been appointed the ﬁ rst Lokpal of India (a retired Supreme Court Judge).

The Constitution of India recognizes and protects religious and linguistic minorities. Which of these statements are correct ?

questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (A). Further vide notiﬁ cation dated 27th January, 2014, Jains have also been notiﬁ ed as minority community. Thus six communities has notiﬁ ed as minorities at present. At present statement 1 is also false. Zoroastrians is not the smallest religious minority as there exist other smaller minorities which are not notiﬁ ed as minorities. The Constitution of India recognizes and protect religious and linguistic minorities. Thus only statement 4 is correct at present.

It has formation in each State as State Human Rights Commission. 3. Its powers are only recommendatory in nature. 4. It is mandatory to appoint a woman as a member of the Commission. Which of the above statements are correct ?
questions.questionTextHi: भारत के राष्ट्रीय मानवाधिकार आयोग के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें - 1. इसका अध्यक्ष भारत का सेवानिवृत्त मुख्य न्यायाधीश होना चाहिए। 2. प्रत्येक राज्य में राज्य मानवाधिकार आयोग के रूप में इसका गठन है। 3. इसकी शक्तियाँ प्रकृति में केवल अनुशंसात्मक हैं। 4. आयोग में सदस्य के रूप में किसी महिला को नियुक्त करना अनिवार्य है। उपरोक्त में से कौन सा कथन सही है?
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (A). The Human Rights Commission was established in 1993.The Chairman and members of this Commission are appointed by the President. The Protection of Human Rights (Amendment) Act, 2019 entitles the Chief Justice of the Supreme Court as well as other Judges to be appointed as the chairman of the National Human Right Commission. Apart from this, the number of members (Civil Society) of the Commission has been increased from two to three, in which at least one member must be a woman. Its power are recommendatory in nature. The State Human Rights Commissions are constituted by the States and they are not the part of National Human Rights Commission. So, in the present perspective only statement 3 and statement 4 are true.

Apart from this, the number of members (Civil Society) of the Commission has been increased from two to three, in which at least one member must be a woman. Its power are recommendatory in nature. The State Human Rights Commissions are constituted by the States and they are not the part of National Human Rights Commission.
